_note: Photos of Costa Rica that sit beside the studio's own images on town, cost and land pages. All Unsplash or Pexels licence (no credit required; we credit anyway). scripts/places.py crops each to a 2:1 band around 'focus' (0 top, 1 bottom) and writes site/assets/img/places/<id>-{1600,800}.webp. The alt text says what the photo shows, never that it is the town it illustrates.
